doc.digest: A user interface tab/multiple button object in the style of Ableton Live.
doc.description: live.tab is used to create multiple-button and multi-column displays and interfaces.

methods.name: bang
methods.description: Sends the current item out the outlets.

methods.name: int
methods.digest: Display a tab item and send the current item
methods.description: The number specifies a tab item to be sent out, and causes live.tab to display that item. The items are numbered starting at 0.

methods.name: float
methods.digest: Display a tab item and send the current item
methods.description: The number specifies a tab item to be sent out, and causes live.tab to display that item. The items are numbered starting at 0.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: The word assign, followed by a floating point value, causes that value to be displayed and sent out the live.tab object's outlet. The value, however, will not be stored. If the Parameter Visibility attribute is set to Stored Only, the assign message will not add the new value to the Live application’s undo chain.

methods.name: init
methods.digest: Restore and output the initial value
methods.description: Restore and output the initial value.

methods.name: (mouse)
methods.digest: Click to set a tab selection
methods.description: Clicking on a tab button will highlight and set the selection and send the tab text out the second outlet and the index out the first outlet.

methods.name: outputvalue
methods.description: Sends the current value out the outlet.

methods.name: rawfloat
methods.digest: Store a raw normalized value, convert to real, display, and output
methods.description: A raw normalized value (between 0. and 1.) received in the inlet is converted to a real value, stored, displayed by live.tab, and the current value is sent out the outlet.

methods.name: set
methods.digest: Display a menu item without triggering output
methods.description: The word set, followed by a number, specifies a menu item to be displayed by live.tab without triggering any output.

methods.name: setsymbol
methods.digest: Display a tab item without triggering output
methods.description: The word setsymbol, followed by a symbol that specifies a tab item, causes live.tab to display that item, but does not cause any output.

methods.name: symbol
methods.digest: Display a tab item and report output
methods.description: The word symbol, followed by a symbol that specifies a tab item, causes live.tab to display that item and send the tab text out the second outlet and the index out the first outlet.
